deploy-bot: Initiating release candidate deploy to prod (env=prod, tag=rc-2026-03-20, commit=abc1234). Running CI gate checks now.

ci-checker-bot: CI gate result: BLOCKED — 3 failing checks, 5 passed. Failed jobs: `smoke/api-health`, `integration/orders-flow`, `unit:billing::InvoiceTest#roundtrip`.

Alex Wong: Copy. Can someone paste the failing logs? I'm not seeing this locally.

Maria Gonzalez: Pasting minimal failing output from CI:
```
FAIL integration/orders-flow - Timeout waiting for order processing (30s)
ERROR unit:billing::InvoiceTest#roundtrip - expected 42 but got 41
FAIL smoke/api-health - 503 returned from /health endpoint
```

Tom Berger: Looks suspiciously like a consumer timing issue. This RC bumped `kafka-client` 2.1.0 -> 2.2.0 in the service image. Suggest we hold canary and rerun the flaky suites first.

Sara Liu: Agree with holding canary. If the rerun still fails, we should pin to the previous verified commit (def5678) and re-run smoke. Maria — can you trigger a rerun of the failed jobs?

Maria Gonzalez: Rerun triggered: `ci:rerun --jobs=smoke,integration,unit/billing` (build id 88541). Link: https://ci.example.com/builds/88541. ETA ~7m.

ci-checker-bot: Rerun finished: 2/3 failing (integration/orders-flow still flaked). Deploy remains BLOCKED by CI gate.

Alex Wong: Two runs with the same integration flake + dependency bump = risky. I recommend we rollback/pin to `def5678` for prod safety and re-run full smoke. Thoughts? :warning: :thumbsup:

Tom Berger: +1 from infra. I'll open the rollback PR and pin the release tag to `def5678`. Taking ownership of the rollback.

Sara Liu: Filing a follow-up to track RCA and next steps: INF-4212. Pinged release manager @Maria Gonzalez for approval to delay the release window if needed.

deploy-bot: Deploy PAUSED by CI gate (reason: failing checks). Action items recorded: rollback PR created (#4321) by Tom, rerun link https://ci.example.com/builds/88541, and postmortem ticket INF-4212. Deploy will remain paused until `approve-deploy` is issued by the release lead.

Alex Wong: Thanks — once rollback PR is merged, can we run a quick smoke before unblocking?

Tom Berger: Yep — will run smoke immediately after merge and post results in this thread.

Maria Gonzalez: Acknowledged. I'll hold off on any manual unblock until we see green smoke.
